patch_list: Shooty Skies Ad-Free (Ads blocked + instant rewards)
Blocks banner, interstitial, app-open and native ads, and turns rewarded videos into instant rewards — nothing is ever fetched or displayed.
Every store item is free — tap "Buy" and the purchase completes instantly with no Google Play payment, and owned items like ad removal are granted at startup.
